summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a news article from an app called "ALIVE PRO." The headline of the article is "DEPP 'RUINED' BY HIS OWN LAVISH SPENDING: LAWSUIT," dated February 1, 2017. There is a notification overlay in the center of the screen prompting the user to "Get YouTube App." The message indicates that the current app requires the YouTube app to function properly, which is not installed on the device. Below the notification, there is a button labeled "Get YouTube App." At the bottom of the screen, there are navigation icons for home, share, and menu options.
